question: After the exact four-head-induced block-11 residual carrier is installed, do particular downstream attention/MLP modules read and rewrite it, or does it travel mainly by residual skip to the final literal readout?
evidence_status: Outcome-blind successor registration while the exact block-11 residual/MLP factorial is queued. Execution is gated on a valid joint closure and a passing dominant residual branch. No v23 downstream module outcome has been opened.

searched: v15 residual suffix-module mediation and residual-state boundary atlases
selected-writer downstream complete-module mediation atlas v2
v23 four-head transport, necessity, and queued residual/MLP factorial
prior_art.nearest_results: Earlier, differently aligned writers showed direct residual carry: no downstream complete module exceeded the selection gate, while a residual-state boundary closed the route but was not control-selective. The current bank has exact target/P/aligned-C endpoints and a different frozen four-head union, so stable selective replication or a real downstream reader are both unresolved.
prior_art.novelty: This tests both sufficiency and necessity of every complete downstream module response for the exact v23 residual branch, on capability-frozen target rows and aligned controls. It does not select a low-rank activation basis.
prior_art.known_lessons: Large module activation response is not mediation. Each candidate therefore gets reciprocal output transfer and output reset. Native module boundaries are only a first screen; a passing attention module must be split into all physical heads before identification.

frozen_design.source: Recompute the exact Delta_y post-attention residual correction from native donor versus four-head-removed block 11 states. Require the predecessor's exact joint closure and dominant residual verdict before execution.
frozen_design.capture: Capture each complete attention c_proj output and MLP output under the four-head-removed and residual-rescued paths, at every token through query.
frozen_design.transfer: Starting from four-head removal without Delta_y, replace exactly one candidate module output by its residual-rescued value. This measures whether that response alone is sufficient to relay the residual branch.
frozen_design.reset: Starting from residual rescue, replace exactly one candidate output by its removed-path value. Loss of residual rescue measures necessity of that module response while the skip carrier remains live.
frozen_design.selection: FIT is group_number mod 4 in {0,1}; HOLDOUT is {2,3}. Rank FIT candidates by the minimum of transfer recovery and reset loss, retain at most four above bars, and validate unchanged identities on HOLDOUT.

predictions.pred_a_authority_residual_replay_hooks_f: The predecessor is valid, the residual rescue replays, every candidate capture/patch hook fires exactly once, reports are finite, and the 28-forward price is exact.
predictions.pred_b_no_single_complete_downstream_mod: No candidate passes both FIT transfer and reset projection 0.15 with cosine 0.85; this replicates direct residual carriage on the better-aligned v23 bank.
predictions.pred_c_any_fit_candidate_validates_witho: If B is false, every retained candidate passes the weaker frozen HOLDOUT transfer/reset bars and target direction bar.
predictions.pred_d_any_validated_candidate_is_select: If candidates validate, their transfer and reset effects have P/C leakage at most 0.15; if none exists this predicate is reported not-applicable rather than passed.
predictions.pred_e_residual_branch_remains_reporter_: The residual-rescue effect has positive signed projection and direction fraction at least 0.90 in both reporter halves.

opposing_predictions.direct_residual_readout: B and E pass; C/D are not applicable. Translate Delta_y through the exact final RMSNorm and lm-head tensor and test held-out/OOD prediction.
opposing_predictions.module_reader: B fails and C/D pass. Split each passing attention module into every physical head, then contract Delta_y with its literal Q/K/V weights and causally validate weight-ranked heads.
opposing_predictions.distributed_reader: B fails but no singleton validates. Run a greedy combination over positive reciprocal module effects, preserving interactions rather than lowering a rank threshold.

null: A failure invalidates the screen. B passing does not prove no downstream computation uses the carrier; it rules out a dominant singleton at complete-module grain and redirects to the exact final reader. C or D failure rejects stable/selective singleton localization and opens a registered greedy combination only if multiple positive effects exist.
anti_rank_drift: This is complete native-module causal patching tied to an exact necessary source branch. No reconstruction, explained variance, DAS optimization, tensor rank, or compression score selects candidates.
decision: A stable selective module opens full physical-head splitting and weight contraction. A clean singleton null promotes direct final-readout testing. Multiple weak positive modules open a greedy combination with a frozen order.
